title: Add an opt-in urgent-interrupt class for peer messages
outcome: Provide an explicit urgent delivery class for safety-relevant cross-session messages such as STOP-the-line or commit-halt instructions. Urgent messages may surface inside a receiver's running turn using the agent platform's mid-turn reminder path instead of waiting behind a long test or build. Ordinary messages remain asynchronous and queued.
acceptance: A sender can append an authorized class=stop message and receives its durable id and delivery disposition. A compatible active receiver sees the pointer plus complete bounded body before its next externally visible action and explicitly cursor-acks it after processing. Oversized STOP is rejected or clearly flagged to the sender. STOP cannot be superseded; release requires an authorized reference. Unsupported-agent fallback, rate limits, duplicate releases, restart, and abuse controls are tested.
